name: News feed
description: Headlines from an RSS or Atom feed, as a list, one at a time, or a ticker.

schema.name: url
schema.label: Feed address
schema.help: The RSS or Atom feed URL (http or https; ports 80, 443, 8080 or 8443). Screens never see it.

schema.name: title
schema.label: Title
schema.help: Shown at the top. Leave empty to use the feed's own title.

schema.name: rotate_seconds
schema.label: Seconds per headline or page
schema.help: How long each headline (one at a time) or each page of the list stays up.

schema.name: show_qr
schema.label: Show a QR code to the article

settings.name: allow_private_hosts
settings.label: Intranet feed hosts
settings.help: Exact host names (one per line) whose feeds may be on a private network address, e.g. intranet.example.local. Loopback and link-local addresses stay blocked.

terms: Feeds and images are fetched by the AiSignX server from the addresses you enter. Make sure you may show the feed's content on public screens.
